summary.headline: Moon–Mercury Applications by Sign
summary.text: Astrological judgments for the Moon’s application after separation to Mercury in Scorpio, Sagittarius, Capricorn, and Aquarius, interpreting conjunction, sextile, square, trine, and opposition aspects through effects on merchants, nobles, markets, weather, children, scholars, and prices.
